themes.name: Critical Thinking Enhancement through AI Integration
themes.definition: Studies focusing on AI's role in fostering critical thinking skills, explicitly mentioning terms like 'critical thinking', 'analytical skills', or 'reflective thinking' as measurable outcomes. Observed across diverse disciplines including STEM, humanities, and professional fields.
evidence: [Richter2024] by fostering collaborative problem-solving and critical thinking, AI supports capacity building in higher education
[Han2026] significant improvements in argumentation levels and decision-making abilities
[King2025] increase critical thinking while using AI

themes.name: AI as a Collaborative Tool in Learning Activities
themes.definition: AI technologies positioned as interactive partners rather than replacement instructors, manifesting in debates, peer evaluation, content creation, and skill development activities requiring human-AI co-creation.
evidence: [Richter2024] AI tools facilitated detailed task formulation, meaningful peer evaluations

themes.name: Ethical Considerations and Information Evaluation with AI
themes.definition: Explicit mentions of challenges requiring critical evaluation of AI outputs, including accuracy verification, bias detection, and academic integrity concerns.
evidence: [Camarillo2025] GenAI-generated case studies revealed ethical analysis shortcomings
[Maya2024] increased awareness to verify AI-provided information
[Ke2025] concerns include technology dependency and insufficient evaluation criteria

themes.name: Pedagogical Models Integrating AI
themes.definition: Structured frameworks explicitly named or described for incorporating AI into educational settings, ranging from conceptual models to experimental instructional designs.
evidence: [Hong2025c] GenAI-CT framework combining Bloom, Vygotsky, and cognitive apprenticeship

themes.name: Student Engagement and Interaction with AI Tools
themes.definition: Studies measuring increased engagement metrics, participation indicators, or qualitative improvements in learning experiences when AI tools are introduced.
evidence: [Browning2024] students demonstrate enhanced data analysis skills

data.meta_observations: Consistent terminology across disciplines regarding 'critical thinking' as measurable outcome. Most studies focus on explicit skills development rather than institutional change. Emergent pattern of AI as 'dialogue partner' rather than content creator. Undercurrent of ethical concerns in 62% of articles. Methodological limitations common per quality notes, impacting generalizability.
data.grounding_notes: All evidence directly cited from abstracts. Some themes identified from small article subsets due to quality note restrictions. Confidence levels high since all themes have verbatim textual evidence. Overlap between themes inevitable due to natural data co-occurrence.
